description: Fake PDF viewer claims a missing font and tells macOS users to paste a base64-obfuscated shell command into Terminal and enter their password.
rationale: Fonts are never installed by pasting an encoded command that pipes into bash; the base64 hides a remote script download, and the job-offer lure increases motivation.
author: Independent test author agent (Claude), blind to VEILTRACE rules, 2026-10-22
